The tests were performed following the motor manufacturer's recommendation; that's the reason all sorts of prop/motor/battery combinations were not tried.

Many generic carbon props were so unbalanced that it wasn't possible to balance them using enamel (nail paint). For such unbalanced props, I recommend putting washers on the blade holding screws.

Tests with the Propdrive 4248 motor did not follow the manufacturer's recommendation because we do not have the props indicated for use with a 4S battery.

It seems that fixed props are better than the generic folding ones. Try to get more with the correct specification. Consider buying a 5S battery if the weight and cost permit.
